text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while getting pumped up for the 
Japanese Derby, Symboli Rudolf called out 
to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"There is no stage more fitting than the 
Nippon Derby to repay my Trainer's trust—"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing those words, Special Week took on 
a somewhat pensive look.
